answers.core: This proposal is relevant for the engine arguments, which can't be modified by scripting. User arguments can already choose to support this syntax. In fact, the [minimal example given in the documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_os.html#class-os-method-get-cmdline-args) *only* supports `--argument=value` syntax, not `--argument value`.

title: Add support for `--argument=value` syntax in engine command line arguments (in addition to `--argument value`)
